instructions: The night before, or at least 6 hours ahead: hull the strawberries and cut them in half. That should be about 2 cups.
Put the strawberries, 2 cups Greek yogurt and 1/4 cup honey in a blender and blend until smooth.
Pour it into 6 popsicle molds, push in the sticks and freeze for 4 to 6 hours, until solid all the way through. This makes 6 popsicles.
To serve, run warm water over the outside of a mold for a few seconds and pull the popsicle out. Eat them straight from the freezer.
advance_prep_notes: Blend and freeze the popsicles the night before, or at least 6 hours ahead.
method_notes: Both blend plain yogurt, fruit and honey until smooth, pour it into molds and freeze it for 4 to 6 hours. Desserts on a Dime (the lead, since neither page has 20 ratings) uses 2 cups Greek yogurt, 2 cups fruit and 1/4 cup honey for 6 popsicles and loosens them under warm water. Baby Foode uses 1 1/2 cups plain yogurt and says to leave out the honey for babies under one. This follows the lead with strawberries as the fruit.
